tests.method: Before rig/material show original generated SDF mesh itself, reproducible seed/code and 4-view images
tests.pass: Source proof visible and provenance pinned

tests.method: Validate connected components, manifold closedness where intended, triangle area, duplicate vertices, face winding, normal finiteness
tests.pass: No unplanned nonmanifold edges, degenerates, floating components, NaN normals; distinguish expected openings

tests.method: Per-vertex influences finite, normalized, existing named bones; compare bind/rest mesh and evaluated rest
tests.pass: No unweighted vertices and within measured numeric float tolerance; report coordinate units

tests.method: Evaluate actual skinned vertex positions at recorded pose matrices; compute per-rest-edge distance ratio and compression inverse, p50/p95/p99/max per semantic region; ignore degenerate zero-length rest edges
tests.pass: Complete metrics per pose/region, no NaNs; thresholds calibrated by actual neutral samples and visually acceptable cartoon deformation, not invented universal 1.25 hard gate

tests.method: Introduce two seeded deliberately broken weight assignments for CL01-A leg midline and CL01-B tail; rerun identical suite
tests.pass: Both broken cases detected with localized affected edges/bones; known-good rest/nonstress poses not broadly false-flagged

tests.method: Export glTF/GLB, cold reopen in target tool/renderer; compare bone names/hierarchy, source scale/pivot/up axis, neutral mesh and sampled pose metrics
tests.pass: Reproduction matches documented tolerance and original source identity; screenshot from post-export renderer

tests.method: Shader uses recorded material slots/region patterns only; no KFB Surface canon mutation
tests.pass: Geometry and material role separable, approved KFB style not replaced

tests.method: Git diff/PR roster against ToolBox and active Composer PR #355
tests.pass: No production file mutation outside isolated Creature Lab proof; KayKit, EyeRig, Asset Registry, World, Sites untouched

interpretation.proposedVisualQA: At minimum front, back, side and 3/4 neutral; selected stress pose before/after; compare with wireframe/bone labels
interpretation.measurements: edge-length ratio is a diagnostic, not proof of correct joint deformation; inspect volume loss, folded faces, face normal inversion, self-intersections and weight boundary where practical
interpretation.policy: No numeric hard thresholds prior to calibration; record chosen region-based thresholds and rationale in result, not silently use this planning file as PASS
interpretation.expectations: For final three-fixture proof: 3 mesh generations; 18 defined pose cases; 2 negative controls; 3 export/reimport checks; counts are PLANNED only
